offence: Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 1 was released into the path of Car 12 which was arriving in the fast lane, causing a collision of the two cars. The Stewards acknowledge that the driver did everything he could to avoid the indicient and therefore no penalty points are issued in this case.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 1 Unsafe Release From A Pit Stop
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
